title: Reverse on an invoiced billable work order works as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billable.
  • Have a second browser window signed in as an Admin to the production test account (app.shopview.com), where Internal Work Orders is not released yet, so today's screen can be compared.
  • In that production window, have a new invoiced billable work order for this test, work order P.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
  4. Click "Reverse".
  5. Open work order P in the production window.
  6. Open the Finance tab.
  7. Open the invoice menu on the Finance tab.
  8. Click "Reverse".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice shows.

Step 3:

  • The menu offers "Reverse" and "Issue Credit", with no "Reopen Work Order".

Step 4:

  • The invoice is reversed; note the status work order 1 shows and what its Finance tab shows.

Step 5:

  • Work order P opens.

Step 6:

  • The invoice shows.

Step 7:

  • The menu offers "Reverse".

Step 8:

  • Work order P shows the same status and the same Finance tab as work order 1 after step 4.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order), story SV-11761 (Story 4, Reopen a closed internal or no-charge work order)

  • S4-N2: “If the work order is billable and invoiced, the existing Reverse behaviour applies, unchanged.”
  • S3-N1: “If the work order is billable, the button reads "Create invoice" and everything works as today.”
